{{Quote|The Gormak found the wreckage. They seek to put it up.|Nodin-Fe|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Nodin-Fe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss commandos|Commando]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Pelath Point]] outpost in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]]. He felt the influence of the [[Evuk-Nosk]], an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] citizen to find it and bury it before the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] could excavate it.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nodin-Fe is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].<ref name="TOR" />
